result.title: Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images
result.summary: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 将预训练单图 image-to-3D 生成器的原生 3D latent 改造为多图联合去噪器，用轻量 correspondence-attention adapter 让每个 3D token 只关注其他图像中的对应点，从而在表情与视角变化下生成一致的头部网格。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用对应关系约束跨图注意力、仅融合相关位置证据并在拟合对应噪声上训练的做法，可能为 LVR 中的多视图视觉证据筛选与对齐提供可核查的机制线索，但任务本身是 3D 网格生成，不涉及推理状态或答案使用。
